/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import urlopen, Request
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from uuid import uuid4

class ActionField(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.name = None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'input':
            name = dict(attrs).get('name', '')
            if name.startswith('"'$ACTION_ID_'"'):
                self.name = name

base = 'http://localhost:3100/'
before = urlopen(base).read().decode()
parser = ActionField()
parser.feed(before)
assert parser.name
unique_title = 'Fresh post ' + uuid4().hex[:8]
body = urlencode({parser.name: '', 'title': unique_title, 'content': 'Created through the Server Action'}).encode()
response = urlopen(Request(base, body, method='POST', headers={'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}))
after_action = response.read().decode()
next_load = urlopen(base).read().decode()
print('Action status:', response.status)
print('Fresh in action response:', unique_title in after_action)
print('Fresh on next page load:', unique_title in next_load)
assert unique_title in after_action and unique_title in next_load
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import urlopen, Request
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from uuid import uuid4

class ActionField(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.name = None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'input':
            name = dict(attrs).get('name', '')
            if name.startswith('"'$ACTION_ID_'"'):
                self.name = name

base = 'http://localhost:3100/'
parser = ActionField()
parser.feed(urlopen(base).read().decode())
boundary = 'test' + uuid4().hex
title = 'Fresh post ' + uuid4().hex[:8]
fields = {parser.name: '', 'title': title, 'content': 'Created through the Server Action'}
body = b''.join(f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{key}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n'.encode() for key,value in fields.items()) + f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
request = Request(base, body, method='POST', headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'})
response = urlopen(request)
after_action = response.read().decode()
next_load = urlopen(base).read().decode()
print('Action status:', response.status, 'Final URL:', response.url)
print('Fresh in action response:', title in after_action)
print('Fresh on next page load:', title in next_load)
print('Response prefix:', after_action[:160])
assert title in after_action and title in next_load
PY"
